title: Driver Incentive Terms, Schedule G1: Guarantee Scale by Driver Agreement Service Level
content:
The locked guarantee of a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings guarantee opt-in is scaled by the level scale, which follows the service level of the driver's driver services agreement under **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing**: the Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV Driver Agreements scale the guarantee by 1.25; the Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL Driver Agreements scale it by 1.1; every other service level leaves it unscaled.

The level scale multiplies the guaranteed amount stated on the offer. Every multiplier of a locked guarantee acts together on that stated amount, and any amount added to a locked guarantee is added to the product; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Schedule G1

| Service level of the driver services agreement | Level scale |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Black Driver Agreement | 1.25 |
| Wayfare Black SUV Driver Agreement | 1.25 |
| Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement | 1.1 |
| Wayfare XL Driver Agreement | 1.1 |
| Wayfare Standard Driver Agreement | Unscaled (1) |
| Wayfare Green Driver Agreement | Unscaled (1) |

The service level read is the one recorded on the driver's driver services agreement.

## Hypothetical figures

| Stated guaranteed amount | Agreement | Stated amount multiplied by the level scale |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | Wayfare Black SUV Driver Agreement | 250.00 |
| 200.00 | Wayfare XL Driver Agreement | 220.00 |
| 200.00 | Wayfare Green Driver Agreement | 200.00 |
